newsitem.title: USA: Genentech buying stake in CytoTherapeutics.
newsitem.headline: Genentech buying stake in CytoTherapeutics.

text.p: Genentech Inc will buy $8.3 million of CytoTherapeutics Inc stock under an agreement for the companies to collaborate in the development of treatments for Parkinson's disease, Huntington's disease and Lou Gehrig's disease, CytoTherapeutics said Tuesday.
Genentech will buy the stock at a premium to the market price per share, CytoTherapeutics said.
Genentech's stock purchase will fund development by CytoTherapeutics of products containing Genentech's treatment of Parkinson's disease, CytoTherapeutics said.
It said Genentech may make further equity purchases and funding that could total more than $50 million.
CytoTherapeutics said the pact calls for its encapsulated cell technology to be used in delivering some of Genentech's proprietary growth factors to the central nervous system.
The effort will aid in developing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases, the companies said.
CytoTherapeutics said Genentech also has granted it licenses to certain of its factors for treating Huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, also known as Lou Gehrig's disease, or ALS.
The agreements supercede a 1994 pact to develop a treatment for Alzheimer's disease. The companies said they "do not expect to pursue Alzheimer's disease as a target at this time."
